candidate.definition_en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.
candidate.explanation_ar: مؤدب أو مهذب. الشخص اللي بيحترم الناس وبيتعامل بذوق.

senses.definition_en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.
senses.definition_ar: مؤدب أو مهذب في التعامل مع الآخرين.
examples: It is polite to say thank you.
Please be polite to the guests.
She gave a polite smile but didn't say anything.
It is polite to say thank you.
Please be polite to the guests.
She gave a polite smile but didn't say anything.
candidate.mnemonic: الـ 'Police' بيحفظ النظام.. والـ 'Polite' بيحفظ الأدب والذوق في التعامل
